findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. Observed that cove base is missing along the wall and floor behind the downstairs bar. Discussed with PIC. Ensure coving is repaired to help prevent pest entry by the next routine inspection. 

6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The facility has two ice bins, one upstairs and one downstairs, both containing mold and mildew.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the ice machine baffles are cleaned regularly.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Wet wiping cloth observed stored on a shelf in the upstairs bar area. CORRECTED- Cloth moved to sanitizer solution. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution when not in use.
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Sanitizer bucket was not available upon inspectors arrival. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC, who prepared a sanitizer bucket. Ensure that sanitizer bucket is prepared during all times of food prep and service.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Upstairs bar (behind 3 compartment sink and behind beer coolers) is unfinished/bare wood. Seal/paint/cover so that surface is smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. [C]
